title: Analog TV: PAL 625/50 test card
description: A synthetic PAL System B vision carrier filling the whole 2.4 MHz slice: a grayscale test card (gradient, centre disc, vertical bars, black/white squares) negative-AM modulated with full H-sync, vertical sync and two interlaced fields, at 183.25 MHz, one antenna's wave steered to bearing 40 deg across the 5-element array, 3 s looped. The decoder locks the line and field timing from the sync pulses, detects PAL 625/50 from the measured line rate (15625 Hz), and reconstructs a soft grayscale luma picture in the video panel (~150 samples per line at 2.4 MHz). Expect a one-off 'Locked PAL 625/50' event; the VFO's Digital squelch opens on the locked video. No talker or bearing (a TV transmitter is a single known source).
